mn127:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn127:2.1: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
mn127:2.2: Ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, yen' āyasmā Anuruddho ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato Anuruddhassa pāde sirasā vandāhi
mn127:2.4: evañ ca vadehi:-- Pañcakaṅgo, bhante, thapati āyasmato Anuruddhassa pāde sirasā vandati evañ ca vadeti:
mn127:2.5: Adhivāsetu kira, bhante, āyasmā Anuruddho Pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa svātanāya attacatuttho bhattaṃ;
mn127:2.6: yena ca kira, bhante, āyasmā Anuruddho pagevataraṃ āgaccheyya,
mn127:2.8: Evaṃ bhante ti kho so puriso Pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa paṭissutvā yen' āyasmā Anuruddho ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avoca:
mn127:2.9: Pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmato Anuruddhassa pāde sirasā vandati evañ ca vadeti:
mn127:2.10: Adhivāsetu kira, bhante, āyasmā Anuruddho Pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa svātanāya attacatuttho bhattaṃ;
mn127:2.11: yena ca kira, bhante, āyasmā Anuruddho pagevataraṃ āgaccheyya,
mn127:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn127:3.2: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
mn127:3.3: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn127:3.4: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad
mn127:4.1: avoca:-Idha, bhante, therā bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā evam āhaṃsu:
mn127:4.5: Yā cāyam, bhante, appamāṇā cetovimutti yā ca mahaggatā cetovimutti, --
mn127:4.6: ime dhammā nānaṭṭhā c' eva nānābyañjanā ca? udāhu ekaṭṭhā, byañjanam eva nānan ti?
mn127:5.1: Tena hi, gahapati, taṃ yev' ettha paṭibhātu, apaṇṇakan te ito bhavissatīti.
mn127:5.3: Yā cāyaṃ appamāṇā cetovimutti yā ca mahaggatā cetovimutti, ime dhammā ekaṭṭhā byañjanam eva nānan ti.
mn127:6.1: Yā cāyaṃ, gahapati, appamāṇā cetovimutti yā ca mahaggatā cetovimutti, ime dhammā nānaṭṭhā c' eva nānābyañjanā ca.
mn127:6.2: Tad aminā p' etaṃ, gahapati, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ, yathā ime dhammā nānaṭṭhā c' eva nānābyañjanā ca.
mn127:7.2: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ iti uddhamadhotiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati;
mn127:7.5: upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā . . . viharati. --
mn127:8.2: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. --
mn127:8.4: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. --
mn127:8.5: Ayam pi vuccati, gahapati, mahaggatā cetovimutti.
mn127:8.6: Idha, gahapati, yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:8.8: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. --
mn127:8.9: Ayam pi vuccati, gahapati, mahaggatā cetovimutti.
mn127:8.10: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ mahārajjaṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. --
mn127:8.12: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā mahārajjāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. --
mn127:8.13: Ayam pi vuccati, gahapati, mahaggatā cetovimutti.
mn127:8.14: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā samuddapariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. --
mn127:8.15: Ayam pi vuccati, gahapati, mahaggatā cetovimutti.
mn127:8.16: Iminā kho etaṃ, gahapati, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā ime dhammā nānaṭṭhā c' eva nānābyañjanā ca.
mn127:9.3: Idha, gahapati, ekacco parittābhā ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati;
mn127:9.4: so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Parittabhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
mn127:9.5: Idha, gahapati, ekacco appamāṇā ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati;
mn127:9.6: so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Appamāṇābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
mn127:9.7: Idha, gahapati, ekacco saṃkiliṭṭhābhā ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati;
mn127:9.8: so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Saṃkiliṭṭhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
mn127:9.9: Idha, gahapati, ekacco parisuddhābhā ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati;
mn127:9.10: so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Parisuddhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
mn127:10.1: Hoti kho so, gahapati, samayo yā tā devatā ekajjhaṃ sannipatanti, tāsaṃ ekajjhaṃ sannipatitānaṃ vaṇṇanānattaṃ hi kho paññāyati no ca ābhānānattaṃ.
mn127:10.2: Seyyathāpi, gahapati, puriso sambahulāni telappadīpāni ekaṃ gharaṃ paveseyya,
mn127:10.3: tesaṃ gharaṃ pavesesitānaṃ accinānattaṃ hi kho paññāyetha, no ca ābhānānattaṃ;--
mn127:10.4: evam eva kho, gahapati, hoti so samayo yā tā devatā ekajjhaṃ sannipatanti, tāsam ekajjhaṃ sannipatitānaṃ vaṇṇanānattaṃ hi kho paññāyati, no ca ābhānānattaṃ.
mn127:11.1: Hoti kho so, gahapati, samayo yā tā devatā tato vipakkamanti, tāsaṃ tato vipakkamantīnaṃ vaṇṇanānattaṃ c' eva paññāyati ābhānānattañ ca.
mn127:11.2: Seyyathāpi, gahapati, puriso tāni sambahulāni telappadīpāni tamhā gharā nīhareyya,
mn127:11.3: tesaṃ tato nīharantānaṃ accinānattañ c' eva paññāyetha ābhānānattañ ca;--
mn127:11.4: evam eva kho, gahapati, hoti so samayo yā tā devatā tato vipakkamanti tāsaṃ tato vipakkamantīnaṃ vaṇṇanānattañ c' eva paññāyati ābhānānattañ ca.
mn127:12.1: Na kho, gahapati, tāsaṃ devatānaṃ evaṃ hoti:
mn127:12.2: Idaṃ amhākaṃ niccan ti vā dhuvan ti vā sassatan ti vā; api ca yattha yatth' eva tā devatā abhinivisanti, tattha tatth' eva tā devatā abhiramanti.
mn127:12.3: Seyyathāpi, gahapati, makkhikānaṃ kājena vā piṭakena vā harīyamānānaṃ na evaṃ hoti:
mn127:12.4: Idaṃ amhākaṃ niccan ti vā dhuvan ti vā sassatan ti vā; api ca yattha yatth' eva tā makkhikā abhinivisanti tattha tatth' eva tā makkhikā abhiramanti;--
mn127:12.5: evam eva kho, gahapati, tāsaṃ devatānaṃ na evaṃ hoti:
mn127:12.6: Idaṃ amhākaṃ niccan ti vā dhuvan ti vā sassatan ti vā; api ca yattha yatth' eva tā devatā abhinivisanti tattha tatth' eva tā devatā abhiramantīti.
mn127:13.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Abhiyo Kaccāno āyasmantānaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avoca:
mn127:13.3: atthi ca me ettha uttariṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ.
mn127:13.4: Yā tā, bhante, devatā ābhā, sabbā tā parittābhā? udāhu sant' ettha ekaccā devatā appamāṇābhā ti?
mn127:13.5: Tadaṅgena kho, āvuso Kaccāna, sant' ettha ekaccā devatā parittābhā, santi pan' etth' ekaccā devatā appamāṇābhā ti.
mn127:14.1: Ko nu kho, bhante Anuruddha, hetu ko paccayo yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ sant' etth' ekaccā devatā parittābhā santi pan' etth' ekaccā devatā appamāṇābhā ti?
mn127:14.2: Tena, āvuso Kaccāna, taṃ yev' ettha paṭipucchissāmi. Yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi.
mn127:14.4: Yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekam rukkhamūlaṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, --
mn127:14.5: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā ti?
mn127:14.6: Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati,
mn127:14.7: ayaṃ imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ mahaggatatarā ti.
mn127:14.9: Yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, --
mn127:14.10: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā ti?
mn127:14.11: Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati,
mn127:14.12: ayaṃ imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ mahaggatatarā ti.
mn127:14.13: Taṃ kim maññasi, āvuso Kaccāna? Yvāyam bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, --
mn127:14.14: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā ti?
mn127:14.15: Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati,
mn127:14.16: ayaṃ imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ mahaggatatarā ti.
mn127:14.17: Taṃ kim maññasi, āvuso Kaccāna? Yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ mahārajjaṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, --
mn127:14.18: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā ti?
mn127:14.19: Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ mahārajjaṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati,
mn127:14.20: ayaṃ imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ mahaggatatarā ti.
mn127:14.21: Taṃ kim maññasi, āvuso Kaccāna? Yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ mahārajjaṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā mahārajjāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati,
mn127:14.22: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā ti?
mn127:14.23: Yvāyaṃ bhikkhu, bhante, yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā mahārajjāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati,
mn127:14.24: ayaṃ imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ mahaggatatarā ti.
mn127:14.25: Taṃ kim maññasi, āvuso Kaccāna? Yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā mahārajjāni mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā samuddapariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, --
mn127:14.26: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā ti?
mn127:14.27: Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā samuddapariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ mahaggatan ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati,
mn127:14.28: ayaṃ imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ mahaggatatarā ti.
mn127:14.29: Ayaṃ kho, āvuso Kaccāna, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ sant' etth' ekaccā devatā parittābhā santi pan' etth' ekaccā devatā appamāṇābhā ti.
mn127:15.2: atthi ca me ettha uttariṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ.
mn127:15.3: Yāvatā, bhante, devatā ābhā, sabbā tā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā? udāhu sant' etth' ekaccā devatā parisuddhābhā ti?
mn127:15.4: Tadaṅgena kho, āvuso Kaccāna, sant' etth' ekaccā devatā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā, santi pan' etth' ekaccā devatā parisuddhābhā ti.
mn127:16.1: Ko nu kho, bhante Anuruddha, hetu ko paccayo yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ sant' etth' ekaccā devatā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā, santi pan' etth' ekaccā devatā parisuddhābhā ti?
mn127:16.2: Tena, āvuso Kaccāna, upaman te karissāmi.
mn127:16.3: Upamāya p' idh' ekacco viññū puriso bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānāti.
mn127:16.4: Seyyathāpi, āvuso Kaccāna, telappadīpassa jhāyato telam pi aparisuddham vaṭṭi pi aparisuddhā;
mn127:16.5: so telassa pi aparisuddhattā vaṭṭiyā pi aparisuddhattā andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati, --
mn127:16.6: evam eva kho, āvuso Kaccāna, idh' ekacco bhikkhu saṃkiliṭṭhābham pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati;
mn127:16.7: tassa kāyaduṭṭhullam pi na suppaṭippasaddhaṃ hoti, thīnamiddham pi na susamūhataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccam pi na suppaṭivinītaṃ hoti;
mn127:16.8: so kāyaduṭṭhullassa pi na suppaṭippassaddhattā thīnamiddhassa pi na susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassa pi na suppaṭivinītattā andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati.
mn127:16.9: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Saṃkiliṭṭhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
mn127:16.10: Seyyathāpi, āvuso Kaccāna, telappadīpassa jhāyato telam pi parisuddhaṃ vaṭṭi pi parisuddhā,
mn127:16.11: so telassa pi parisuddhattā vaṭṭiyā pi parisuddhattā na andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati, --
mn127:16.12: evam eva kho, āvuso Kaccāna, idh' ekacco bhikkhu parisuddhābhāni pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati,
mn127:16.13: tassa kāyaduṭṭhullam pi suppaṭippassaddhaṃ hoti, thīnamiddham pi susamūhataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccam pi suppaṭivinītaṃ hoti;
mn127:16.14: so kāyaduṭṭhullassa pi suppaṭippassaddhattā thīnamiddhassa pi susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassa pi suppaṭivinītattā na andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati.
mn127:16.15: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā parisuddhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
mn127:16.16: Ayaṃ kho, āvuso Kaccāna, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ sant' etth' ekaccā devatā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā, santi pan' etth' ekaccā devatā parisuddhābhā ti.
mn127:17.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Abhiyo Kaccāno āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avoca:--
mn127:17.3: na, bhante, āyasmā Anuruddho evam āha:
mn127:17.4: Evam me sutan ti vā, evaṃ arahati bhavitun ti vā;
mn127:17.5: atha ca pana, bhante, āyasmā Anuruddho: Evam pi tā devatā iti pi devatā tveva bhāsati.
mn127:17.7: Addhā āyasmatā Anuruddhena tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ sannivutthapubban c' eva sallapitapubbañ ca sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbā ti.
mn127:17.8: Addhā kho te ayaṃ, āvuso Kaccāna, āsajja upanīyavācā bhāsitā;
mn127:17.10: Dīgharattaṃ vo me, āvuso Kaccāna, tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ sannivutthapubbañ c' eva sallapitapubbañ ca sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbā ti.
mn127:18.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Abhiyo Kaccāno Pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etad avoca:
mn127:18.2: Lābhā te, gahapati, suladdhan te, gahapati,
mn127:18.3: yaṃ tvañ c' eva taṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pahāsi yam p' imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ alatthamhā savanāyāti. 128.
